# RBT Practice AI

> RBT Practice AI is the premier exam preparation platform for candidates studying for the Behavior Analyst Certification Board® (BACB®) Registered Behavior Technician (RBT®) certification exam aligned with the BACB RBT 3rd Edition Test Content Outline (TCO).

## Core Capabilities & Platform Features
- **85-Question Mock Exam Simulator**: 90-minute timed diagnostic simulations matching Pearson VUE test center specifications with Domain-weighted question distribution.
- **Master Question Bank**: Over 1,500+ scenario-based practice questions crafted by Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) across all 6 BACB 3rd Edition domains.
- **Socrates AI Clinical Tutor**: Conversational AI tutor providing real-time clinical rationales, distractor breakdowns, and clinical roleplay for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) concepts.
- **Leitner 5-Box Spaced Repetition Flashcards**: Algorithmic flashcard engine sorting ABA terminology into 5 mastery boxes for guaranteed long-term retention.
- **Pass-or-Refund Guarantee**: 100% money-back guarantee for candidates who complete three qualifying 85%+ mock exams and sit for the official exam within 30 days.
- **Clinic Enterprise Portal**: Cohort analytics, domain mastery heatmaps, and supervisor oversight tools for ABA clinical directors.

## BACB RBT 3rd Edition Test Content Outline Domains
- **Domain A: Measurement** (Continuous measurement, Discontinuous measurement, Data graphing, Inter-observer agreement).
- **Domain B: Assessment** (Preference assessments, ABC data collection, Functional behavior assessment assistance).
- **Domain C: Skill Acquisition** (DTT, NET, Chaining, Shaping, Token economies, Stimulus control transfer, Prompt fading).
- **Domain D: Behavior Reduction** (Functions of behavior, Differential reinforcement DRO/DRA/DRI/DRL, Extinction, Motivating operations).
- **Domain E: Documentation and Reporting** (Objective session notes, Mandated abuse reporting, Legal & compliance communication).
- **Domain F: Professional Conduct and Scope of Practice** (RBT Ethics Code 2.0, Supervision requirements, Dual relationships, Client dignity).
